visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraved illustration depicting a group of people swimming or wading in a body of water near a rocky cliffside. In the upper right, atop the rocky cliff, two smaller figures are visible. The style is that of a 19th-century ink or pencil sketch.
